{"question": "What year did John start surfing?", "similar_sentence": ["D3:27-1:John:I started surfing five years ago and it's been great. I love the connection to nature.", "D14:2-1:Tim:Hey John! Long time no see! Can't wait to catch up and hear all about what you've been up to.", "D21:14-4:John:Nice one! Learning something new is always a great adventure. Keep up the hard work and let's see where you end up. It's all about dedication and effort. It feels great to finally achieve something after putting in so much time and energy. and shared a photography of a man sitting on the ground with a trophy", "D16:1-1:Tim:Hey John, long time no see! Hope you've been doing well. Since we last chat, some stuff's happened. Last week, I had a huge writing issue - got stuck on a plot twist and couldn't find my way out. It was crazy frustrating, but I kept pushing and eventually got the ideas flowing again.", "D20:40-2:John:Yeah, nature's great for clearing the mind and calming the soul. This was my Rocky Mountains trip last year and it was stunning. Seeing those mountains, fresh air - it makes you realize how incredible the world is. and shared a photo of a mountain with a snow covered peak in the distance", "D7:13-1:John:It's really motivating to have something that reminds you of why you started, and having supportive people around is like having a cheer team that helps you through tough times.", "D17:4-1:Tim:Wow! Sounds like an incredible road trip. I'm glad you and your wife had such a great time! and shared a photo of a statue of a woman with a blue hat on", "D3:6-1:Tim:Wow, sounds like a blast! I had an incredible time meeting with that fellow fan. You can really feel the love when you're surrounded by people who share the same passion. Does that happen with your sport too?", "D19:6-2:John:Last season, I had a major challenge when I hurt my ankle. It required some time off and physical therapy. It was frustrating because I couldn't play or help the team. I stayed focused on my recovery and worked hard to strengthen my body. It was a tough mental and physical challenge, but it made me realize the importance of patience and perseverance. I'm grateful that I was able to overcome it.", "D14:1-1:John:Hey Tim! Long time no talk - a lot has been going on since then!", "D3:26-1:Tim:Wow! How long have you been surfing?", "D8:15-2:John:Wow, that's cool! Music really has a way of bringing back memories and evoking emotions, doesn't it? Almost like taking us back in time. Could you tell me more about that film and the memories it brings up for you?", "D7:11-2:John:Having something like this ball to remind me of the bond and support from my teammates is really comforting. It's a nice reminder of why I started playing basketball and my journey. It motivates me to stay strong and give it my all.", "D9:14-1:John:Sure thing! Any time you need help, don't hesitate to reach out.", "D3:29-1:John:Yup! Being out in the water can be amazing. The waves, the wind, it's super exciting and free-feeling. Talk to you later!", "D11:19-1:John:I've thought about it a lot. I want to use my platform to make a positive difference and inspire others - maybe even start a foundation and do charity work. It's important to me to make the most of the chances I get and leave a meaningful legacy.", "D3:32-1:Tim:Yeah! It's great to find stuff that makes us happy and feel free. It's like bliss for me when I do this in a comfy spot. It's like being in another world, same as surfing is for you. and shared a photo of a living room with a brown couch and a white ottoman", "D27:8-2:John:I've always wanted to learn Spanish. I'm doing OK, cheers for asking. Last week I visited home and caught up with my family and old friends. We had a great time talking about our childhood - it reminds me of the good ol' times! and shared a photo of a group of girls basketball players posing for a picture", "D28:12-1:John:The game turned out to be a total success! Lots of people showed up and had a great time, plus we were able to raise some money for charity.", "D20:32-2:John:Definitely! It grounds us and makes us appreciate the simple beauty around us. We should take time to enjoy it. and shared a photo of a lake with a rock in the middle of it", "D24:1-1:Tim:Hey John, catch up time! What've you been up to? Finding the right spot was tough but here we are! and shared a photo of a gym with a basketball court and cones", "D15:30-2:John:Yep, I totally get it! Cuddling up with a book is my chill time. And when I'm away from the court, cooking is therapy for me. It's a good way to be creative and experiment with flavors while taking a break. Here's a photo of me cooking a meal. and shared a photo of a slow cooker filled with a mixture of food", "D17:17-1:John:Yeah, taking time for ourselves is crucial. It helps us stay sharp and focused. Plus, it helps us gain new perspectives and tackle challenges with more energy. Finding the right balance is key and I'll keep that in mind as I continue my journey.", "D26:25-2:John:Thanks! I'm really glad I can make a difference. Have you been doing anything new in your free time?", "D16:6-1:John:Yeah, last year I had a basketball game where we were trailing big time in the 4th quarter. We had to dig deep and keep on pushing to overturn the deficit and it was amazing when that final buzzer sounded. Unforgettable feeling.", "D12:1-1:Tim:Hey John! Awesome catchin' up with you! A lot's changed since last time. and shared a photo of a bookcase filled with dvds and games", "D28:1-1:Tim:Hey John, long time no talk. On Friday, I got great news - I'm finally in the study abroad program I applied for! Next month, I'm off to Ireland for a semester.", "D9:4-1:John:We were teammates for four years in high school, so we've played together for quite some time. Have you ever been part of a sports team?", "D26:1-2:John:Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. My week's been busy - I started doing seminars, helping people with their sports and marketing. It's been awesome! and shared a photo of a basketball court with a crowd of people watching", "D21:4-1:John:I've been playing professionally for just under a year now. It's been a wild ride."]}
